strings.zh: 欢迎来到遗迹小屋！{SCROLL}这里是对在遗迹出土的{NEWLINE}远古精灵石版{CLEAR}进行复原作业的地方。{SCROLL}触摸四个边角{NEWLINE}石版碎片会旋转,{SCROLL}按住移动{NEWLINE}可以移到其他地方,{SCROLL}这样进行操作{NEWLINE}应该能够将其复原到{CLEAR}原来的状态……
strings.en: Welcome to the ruins hut!{SCROLL}We are reconstructing ancient Pokémon{NEWLINE}stone panels excavated from the ruins.{SCROLL}Touch at the four corners to rotate{NEWLINE}the stone-panel pieces.{SCROLL}Press and hold a piece, then drag it to{NEWLINE}move it around.{SCROLL}We think we should be able to restore{NEWLINE}them to their original state...
strings.notes: US 0074/0 [D-2053 meaning-review-30: independently LLM-reviewed source-faithful correction; not human-approved.]

strings.zh: 您、您{NEWLINE}复原了石版吗……！？{SCROLL}太厉害了！{NEWLINE}天才考古学家出现了！{CLEAR}是吧！
strings.en: You reconstructed the stone panel?{SCROLL}That’s great!{NEWLINE}We have an archaeology genius here!

strings.zh: 隐藏在海底,{NEWLINE}用背部的眼睛观察四周的精灵。
strings.en: A Pokémon that hid on the seafloor{NEWLINE}and watched its surroundings{CLEAR}with the eyes on its back.
strings.notes: Puzzle-room hint (Kabuto panel); the US ROM blanks this string.

strings.zh: 小银『根据我收集的情报,{NEWLINE}阿鲁夫遗迹应该封印着一只{CLEAR}传说中的超强精灵。{CLEAR}要是能得到这样一只精灵,{CLEAR}可比100只弱鸡精灵强多了……
strings.en: Silver: According to the intel I’ve{NEWLINE}gathered, a legendary, super-strong{CLEAR}Pokémon is sealed in the Ruins of Alph.{CLEAR}Getting a Pokémon like that would{CLEAR}beat having 100 weakling Pokémon...

strings.zh: 小银『是你！联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}！{SCROLL}小银『你是来这抓我的吗……{NEWLINE}没办法,只好先下手为强了！
strings.en: Silver: It’s you! League{NEWLINE}Champion {VAR:0103:0}!{SCROLL}Silver: You came here to{NEWLINE}catch me...? Then I’ve got{CLEAR}no choice. I’ll strike first!

strings.zh: 小银『可恶啊,我要是有满级的{NEWLINE}传说中精灵,才不会输给你呢！
strings.en: Silver: Damn it! If I had a{NEWLINE}max-level legendary Pokémon,{CLEAR}I’d never lose to you!

strings.zh: 阿金『我在外面听到这边有动静,{NEWLINE}我还以为是找到失踪的女孩了,{CLEAR}原来是偶像在抓小偷啊！
strings.en: Gold: I heard a commotion{NEWLINE}over here from outside. I thought{CLEAR}someone had found the missing girl,{CLEAR}but it’s my idol catching a thief!

strings.zh: 水晶『唉？他就是偷走{NEWLINE}空木博士精灵的那个人吗……？
strings.en: Crystal: Huh? Is he the one who{NEWLINE}stole Professor Elm’s Pokémon...?

strings.zh: 小银『切！真是屋漏偏逢连夜雨……
strings.en: Silver: Tch! When it rains, it pours...

strings.zh: 阿金『嘿嘿,这里没法使用穿洞绳,{NEWLINE}我看你能往哪跑！
strings.en: Gold: Heh heh. You can’t use an Escape{NEWLINE}Rope in here. Let’s see you run now!

strings.zh: 小银『混蛋,我怎么能栽在这里……
strings.en: Silver: Damn it, how could I get{NEWLINE}cornered in a place like this...

strings.zh: 水晶『前辈,阿金这样跟进去太冒失了,{NEWLINE}我有点担心他。{CLEAR}咱们一起追上去帮他吧！
strings.en: Crystal: Gold’s being way too{NEWLINE}reckless, charging in after him{CLEAR}like that. I’m worried about him.{CLEAR}Let’s go after them and help him!
